answer_text:
Here is a comprehensive breakdown of the temperatures at which food can be accepted upon delivery, based on food safety guidelines:

---

## 🌡️ Food Receiving Temperature Guidelines

### ❄️ Cold Foods (TCS – Time/Temperature Control for Safety)
- **General Cold TCS Foods** (meat, poultry, fish, etc.): Receive cold TCS food at **41°F (5°C) or lower**, unless otherwise specified.

- **Live Shellfish** (oysters, mussels, clams, scallops): Receive at an air temperature of **45°F (7°C)** and an internal temperature no greater than **50°F (10°C)**. Once received, the shellfish must be cooled to 41°F (5°C) or lower.

- **Shucked Shellfish**: Should be **45°F or lower**, and cooled to 41°F or lower within four hours.

- **Milk**: Milk can be received at an air temperature of **45°F (7°C) or lower**, but should be refrigerated at or below 41°F (5°C) upon receiving.

- **Shell Eggs**: Eggs should be received at **45°F or lower**.

---

### 🔥 Hot Foods
- **Hot TCS Foods**: Receive hot TCS food at **135°F (57°C) or higher**.

---

### 🧊 Frozen Foods
- Frozen food should be **frozen solid** when received.
- Look for signs of thawing and refreezing, such as ice crystals in the box, fluids or water stains on the case, or frozen liquids on or in the packages.

---

### ⚠️ The Temperature Danger Zone
The danger zone is the temperature range where bacteria thrive: **41°F to 135°F**. Within this range, pathogens like Salmonella, E. coli, and Listeria multiply rapidly. Bacteria can double in number every 20 minutes when food sits at these temperatures.

---

### 🚫 When to Reject Food
If food temperatures do not meet requirements, or if TCS food shows evidence of previous temperature abuse, **do not accept the food**, or discard the products.

---

### 📋 Quick Reference Summary

| Food Type | Acceptance Temperature |
|---|---|
| Cold TCS Foods (meat, poultry, fish) | 41°F (5°C) or lower |
| Live Shellfish | 45°F (7°C) air / 50°F (10°C) internal |
| Shucked Shellfish | 45°F (7°C) or lower |
| Milk | 45°F (7°C) or lower |
| Shell Eggs | 45°F (7°C) or lower |
| Hot TCS Foods | 135°F (57°C) or higher |
| Frozen Foods | Frozen solid (0°F / -18°C or below) |

Always use a **calibrated food thermometer** when checking temperatures at receiving!
